correctness.rationale: From the exact four cells of the stated no-subsidy national-welfare matrix, the payoff gap tariff-minus-free equals -D_A for A and -D_B for B, independent of the opponent mix because foreign-tariff export-loss terms cancel. For D_A,D_B>0, F is strictly dominant and (F,F) unique Nash. The binary two-population replicator becomes decoupled logistic decay with solution x(t)=x0/(x0+(1-x0)e^{D_A t}), similarly y, strictly converging to zero for 0<x0,y0<1. The source’s separately printed Eq(8) cross slope A_I=S_I+exp^I(0)+exc^I(0)>0 under no subsidy and positive baseline producer surplus conflicts with the zero slopes forced by its OWN Section5.1 matrix. Independently re-expanded exact symbolic payoff gap and checked restrictions at boundary.

value.rationale: This is not a freestanding textbook dominance statement: in the specific published model, the table is presented as supporting reciprocal-tariff equilibrium and richer coupled dynamics, yet its exact payoffs eliminate all strategic cross-dependence and force a unique welfare-table equilibrium and explicit flow.
